comment: One tool universe, four provider shapes. Shared by test/wire.test.mjs and adapters/hermes/test_wire.py so the JS and Python shrinkers cannot drift. Long descriptions are the point: they must exceed the caps the tests assert on.
longDescription: Locate files by glob pattern. Searches recursively from the given root, honours .gitignore by default, skips hidden directories unless asked, follows symlinks only when the follow flag is set, and returns results ordered by last modification time so the freshest file comes first.
longNested: Directory to start the search from. Relative paths resolve against the session workspace root, and a trailing slash means the directory itself is matched rather than its contents.

messages.content:
Lead line about the agent.

## Personality

You are terse and direct, and you never pad an answer with a preamble that repeats the question back.

## Tools

Call tools by name with JSON arguments. Prefer the narrowest tool that answers the question, and read before you edit.

## Environment

Working directory is the session workspace.

function.name: find_files
function.description: Locate files by glob pattern. Searches recursively from the given root, honours .gitignore by default, skips hidden directories unless asked, follows symlinks only when the follow flag is set, and returns results ordered by last modification time so the freshest file comes first.

root.description: Directory to start the search from. Relative paths resolve against the session workspace root, and a trailing slash means the directory itself is matched rather than its contents.

function.name: read
function.description: Read a UTF-8 text file and return line-numbered content.

function.name: secret_tool
function.description: A tool the shrinker must be told to leave alone entirely, with a description long enough that a bare character cap would otherwise have cut it down to a stub and reported nothing suspicious about doing so.
